joke.alt: The website promises 2 AM. The website is asleep at 2 AM.

observation: Local contractors advertise 24/7 emergency service but offer no observable after-hours booking or chat.
opportunity: Missed-call text-back plus after-hours intake. A fast text response bridges the gap between a missed call and a human callback.

evidence: 7 of 12 Grand Junction shops claim 24/7 or emergency service
0 of 12 show any live chat or real booking widget
